datasets.title: Zimbabwe Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Zimbabwe Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/zimbabwe_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Zimbabwe to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Survey results were spatially coded and compiled into monthly geographic datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for 2021, representing the current food security situation at district/regional administrative levels.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to assess acute food insecurity severity and geographic extent.
